formal_decision.executive_summary: The project has established verified evaluation infrastructure, leakage-free spatial partitioning, audited metric calculations, and an optimized explainable rule baseline. However, genuine human annotation of the 500-pair representative stratified queue remains incomplete (1 / 500 human-verified). Training a supervised classifier (e.g. LightGBM, XGBoost) solely on the 50 targeted ambiguity cases would introduce catastrophic selection bias (86% positive prevalence, high anomaly density) and severe population misalignment. Therefore, supervised model training is formally blocked until the 500-pair representative sample is human-annotated and QC-validated.
unblocking_requirements: 1. Complete human annotation of the remaining 499 pairs in the representative queue (assigned_sample_500.csv).
2. Complete independent blind second review on the 100-pair QC queue (assigned_representative_qc_representative_reviewer_2.csv).
3. Verify empirical inter-annotator agreement on the representative queue achieves Cohen's kappa >= 0.70 and Krippendorff's alpha >= 0.70.
4. Maintain strict component-blocked spatial partitioning and train using Horvitz-Thompson sampling weights.
